fields.title: 6. Unpublished Runs — Absorption Record Maintained
fields.md:
The four unpublished runs injected by the workflow (10/29 · 11/06 · 11/07 · 11/08) have already been reconfirmed and absorbed, using the primary sources, by the monthly `2026-11` (10/29) and `2026-11-09-event` (11/06~08). This run does not use the copies as sources; it re-verified the facts from each run that can still be confirmed now — no public response on T7 · no follow-up filing after the 11/06 8-K · Flight 15 NET 11/13 — and appended them to `state.run.unpublished_runs[].absorbed_by`. The statement 'Customer A = Google' in the 11/08 copy is not adopted (the 11/09 correction stands — Customer A = U.S. government) (Sources: `_probe/unpublished/*.md` · `state.run.unpublished_runs` · [11/09 run](2026-11-09-event.md) section 1-2).
